title: YAML doesn't know why: building the business context your agents are missing
description:
How an Anaconda data scientist built the business context layer his AI agents were missing, on the dbt MCP server, dbt skills, and the Semantic Layer. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Pedro Heyerdahl, a data scientist at Anaconda explains that technical capability was never the gap for AI agents; organizational knowledge in Slack threads and PR explanations was. After two failed approaches (one giant memory file, then plain RAG), the working design extracts atomic facts and decisions with temporal validity. In a live demo, an agent traced a revenue spike from the dbt project to a known backend bug, named the engineer who fixed it, and logged the investigation back in.

In this session you'll learn:
• How the dbt MCP, dbt skills, the Wizard CLI, and the Semantic Layer work together
• Why plain RAG failed and what replaced it
• How to give agents organizational context with temporal validity

Speaker: Pedro Heyerdahl, data scientist, Anaconda

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai
